liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Praises the transition into Morning Dew, calling it a killer gem despite the link; Identifies the Terrapin to Morning Dew transition as the obvious highlight of the night [9][16]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer cites this as their favorite 1977 version of the song [8]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Notes the recording cuts out at the climax of Garcia's solo [10]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Highlights beautiful vocals from Jerry Garcia during this performance [8]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Calls this the finest seven minutes of music the band played in 1977 [17]

## The recordings

- **gd77-06-07.sbd.hollister-bode.24291.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 182 min; rated 4.71/5 by 14 [1]
- **gd1977-06-07.mtx.seamons.99001.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 183 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1977-06-07.aud.bertrando.31951.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 182 min; rated 5/5 by 10 [4]. Said about its sound: Notes a channel drop-out cross-faded to mono from Morning Dew into Around & Around [4]
- **gd1977-06-07.144910.akg.d224.bertrando.troy.miller.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: source not stated; 22 songs; 187 min [5]. Said about its sound: Reports that Funiculi Funicula is slightly clipped due to tape deterioration issues [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls it weaker than the much better shows on the following two nights [7]
- States the March run is superior, but the June run is also worth downloading [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-06-07.sbd.hollister-bode.24291.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MR>DAT with AMR>DAT Patches [1]. Also: Received from David Hollister; uploader notes it had not previously circulated on etree; Lists the full setlist, including encores Uncle John's Band and U.S. Blues [1][14]
- **gd1977-06-07.mtx.seamons.99001.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC) [2]. Also: Traces lineage from MAR to Reel, DAT, CDs, and finally FLAC conversion [2]
- **gd1977-06-07.aud.bertrando.31951.flac16**: source: AUD, Likely: MAR > Reel > DAT > CDs (See note below) [4]. Also: Consensus attributes the tape to Bob Menke and Reinhardt Hollwein using AKG D224 mics [4]
- **gd1977-06-07.144910.akg.d224.bertrando.troy.miller.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Sandy Troy; transferred by Matt Smith, Charlie Miller, Sirmick; source: AKG D224s > Tandberg 10X > 10 in Master Reel @ 7.5 ips - Taped by Sandy Troy and provided by Charlie Miller [5]
